displayName: 叶羊露芽 Leaf Sheep Dewleaf
description: Original Leaf Sheep Dewleaf sea-slug companion by Cozy Critters Studio, inspired by Costasiella morphology with a creamy continuous foot, two dark-tipped rhinophores and attached green leaf-shaped cerata. Nine independently drawn animation states include muscular gliding, algae-ribbon exploration, bubble watching and a stylized buoyant-pad rise. An original exploratory design, not an exact species reconstruction or a claim of market popularity.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
